name: Legal Compliance Task
description: Task with legal compliance annotations using deontic modalities (obligation, prohibition, permission)

properties.label: Deontic Modality
properties.description: Type of deontic operator: obligation (MUST), prohibition (MUST NOT), or permission (MAY)

properties.label: Deontic ID
properties.description: Unique identifier for this deontic statement (e.g., OBL_001, PRH_001, PER_001)

pattern.message: Must follow pattern: OBL_xxx, PRH_xxx, or PER_xxx

properties.label: Agent (Who)
properties.description: Who must/must not/may perform the action? (e.g., AI_Provider, Data_Controller, Manufacturer)

properties.label: Action (What)
properties.description: What action must/must not/may be performed? (e.g., establish, conduct, deploy, process)

properties.label: Object (On What)
properties.description: What is the action performed on? (e.g., risk_management_system, personal_data, medical_device)

properties.label: Regulation Name
properties.description: Name of the legal regulation or standard

properties.label: Article/Section
properties.description: Article, section, or clause number (e.g., Article 9, Section 5.2, Clause 3.1)

properties.label: Original Legal Text
properties.description: Exact quote from the legal text for traceability and provenance

properties.label: Regulation URI
properties.description: Official URI or URL of the regulation (e.g., EUR-Lex, legislation.gov.uk, FDA.gov)

properties.label: Confidence Score
properties.description: Confidence score (0.0-1.0) if this annotation was extracted automatically from legal text

properties.label: Extraction Method
properties.description: Method used to create this annotation

properties.label: Annotator
properties.description: Person or system that created this annotation

properties.label: Annotation Date
properties.description: Date when this annotation was created (YYYY-MM-DD)
